descriptionHtml:
Approach · EFS Empty & Failure States · S07 Summary fails, then a second Save succeeds: dictation intact throughout, Generate locked, then unlocked (both contexts)

UAT steps / ticket ACs covered:

  • U3a Pre-round summary failed: the raw dictation is kept, an error is shown, and Generate stays disabled until a Save succeeds (PR #53). (UAT EFS state 3; TFA-94745 state 3; TFA-92588 AC 8 (first sentence))
  • U13 Nothing the physician dictated or typed is lost in any failure state. (UAT EFS Expected Result; TFA-94745 AC 3)
  • U11 Every state shows a clear, plain-language message in the app's existing style that tells the physician what to do next (retry, enable permission, sign in, check connection). (UAT EFS Expected Result; TFA-94745 AC 1; TFA-94745 AC 5)
  • U14 Every state works in both Hospital and Nursing Home, on web, iOS and Android. (UAT EFS Expected Result; UAT 3.3; TFA-94745 AC 6)

Test design technique: State transition (state-transition) — Go through the steps in order (add → edit → delete, day 1 → day 2, offline → online) and check the state after each step.

Given Standard fixture; the harness makes the first ai/parsing:parsePreRoundNotes call of each chart fail and lets the next one through

When Type the pre-round text and press Save Note (fails); look at the Encounter tab; reload and look at the Pre-Round and Encounter tabs; open the pre-round again and press Save Note (succeeds); look at the Pre-Round and Encounter tabs again. Hospital, then Nursing Home

Then After the failure, and again after a reload: the typed text is still there word for word, an error says the summary did not update and to save again, Generate is disabled. After the successful Save: the failure message is gone, today's values show and Generate is enabled

Pass rule (oracle, excerpt): From U3a/U13: h1/n1 and, after the reload, h3/n3 mustContain the full typed text, one failure word and one next-step phrase (two mustContainAny groups, both must match); h2/n2 and h4/n4 mustContain the [disabled] Generate button; h5/n5 mustContain today's values and none of the failure messages (the values are also in the typed text, so h5 proves the failure cleared, not that …

Where it ran: dev; test method PW · Playwright script; lane planned in the matrix: browser agent (blocked)

S07 is our own case number (its number in the coverage matrix cases/EFS.matrix.json), not a step number of the UAT document.

Environment: dev — dev deployment, build e02167f (Deploy Convex, 2026-10-12T18:24:27Z); account and address are not written into the report; run folder runs/2026-10-14-dev.

Test method: PW · Playwright script; secondary: FAULT · Fault injection — as classified in cases/test-methods.json, which says it runs on local; Source: dev.
